name: Crew Board
office_task: Put each lawn or field-service job on the right licensed crew member at a time that fits, tell the customer and the tech once, and hand anything it cannot place to the dispatcher.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id and holds its schedule (ServiceM8, Simpro or Jobber)
the tech licence register the business keeps

emits.write: one slot on the job's schedule in the job system (tech, start, end, resolved address, who or which rule set it, what displaced it), updated in place on a change and never written twice
emits.readback: the job system returns the slot's external id, and reading the job's slot back by job_id returns that external id and the job version it was made for; no id back is a failed write, escalated as write_failed, and nothing is sent

emits.write: an escalation on the job naming its owner: an address that will not resolve, no tech with a current licence for the job, a window nobody can meet, no capacity, no consent to message the customer, a failed slot write, or a displaced job that could not be re-slotted
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the job_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
